# Sidali DJEGHBAL

> Sidali DJEGHBAL is a frontend-focused Software Engineer with full-stack experience, specializing in high-interactivity React, Next.js, and TypeScript applications, data-intensive dashboards, backend APIs, and accessible multilingual/RTL web interfaces. He ships end-to-end tested production web platforms, visual block editors, and custom CMS tools for remote teams.

## Experience

- Algerian Tech Makers (tech branch of Bunian) — Frontend Engineer (Full Stack), Remote (Mar 2026 – Present): Architected Bunian's responsive bidirectional (RTL/LTR) Next.js public web platform with RSC, JSON-LD, and dynamic sitemaps; built a custom React-Admin CMS and drag-and-drop block newsletter composer.
- TechGeeks — Frontend Engineer, Hybrid (Oct 2024 – Jan 2026): Engineered the SolveIt 3.0 interactive learning interface (embedded code editor, 3D dashboard, side-by-side Blockly-to-C code generator) and step-by-step algorithm walkthroughs.
- Daad Blockly — Author & Maintainer, Remote / Open Source (May 2025 – Aug 2025): Built a visual-to-source code generator and 50+ custom Blockly definitions backed by a DOM-free core state layer tested with Vitest, plus multi-OS Electron release pipelines.
